question: After the 1551 NLC physical holding was census-bound in 12DJ, can OPAC, public-surrogate, microform-catalog, census-variant, or Chinese-ancient-books-union-bibliography routes expose a direct page surrogate or an independent second holding/copy suitable for target-table collation?
answer: OPAC IDENTITY IS STRENGTHENED, BUT NO DIRECT PAGE SURROGATE OR SECOND INDEXED HOLDING IS FOUND IN THE REVIEWED PUBLIC ROUTES. NLC OPAC directly binds doc 001790345 / internal id 411999023866 / call 14202 to the 1551 Zhicheng copper-movable-type copy in the South Rare Books Reading Room. Wikimedia Commons identifier/title searches return zero; Internet Archive identifier searches return zero and broad title searches return unrelated objects. The OLCC B1MICU microform Z39.50 service accepts the connection but rejects anonymous searches with an access-control error, so its displayed zero hit counts have no negative authority. Google Books exposes the 2015 microform union catalog volume but SearchWithinVolume2 reports searchable:false. Broad National Ancient Books Census title/imprint variants still return only the known NLC target record; the Zhicheng movable-type query returns only the target plus a 1552 Mozi copy, both NLC. Finally, the NLC Chinese Ancient Books Union Bibliography fuzzy result set for title LIKE 通書類聚 is exhaustively closed at all 48 pages / 576 unique records; after full-record filtering there are zero hits for the contiguous target title, keze/jueze terms, Yao Kui, Wang Yining, Zhicheng, or target romanized-title/person forms. Only one exact 1551/Jiajing-30 record occurs and it is an unrelated Guwen Leichao. This closes these indexed public discovery routes only. It does not prove no private, historical, uncatalogued, authenticated-microform, reader-terminal, or nonpublic surrogate exists, and it contributes no numeric/table ancestry vote.
